attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page carries one sentence of life and a couplet and nothing else, so there is nothing to tell him apart by except the name and the day; the corpus holds no other Anthion in any spelling. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence — the four entries that carry it on this day are refused and named in the reader's report.
